findings: Rate limiter is in-memory only — Will not work correctly across multiple app instances. Production deployments must use Redis or similar for a shared store.

Background failures not retried — Email and stock decrement failures are logged but not retried. Orders remain in `pending_payment_verification` state indefinitely if these tasks fail. Consider implementing a retry mechanism or an admin queue for failed operations.
Stock decrement has no validation — The background task decrements stock without checking current inventory. If stock is already low or zero, decrement can create negative stock values.

Email timeout may be too short — The 5-second timeout on the send-email fetch may be insufficient if the email service is under load. Consider increasing to 10–15 seconds or implementing a retry with exponential backoff.
